summary: TransparentBusiness, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting asset swap agreements involving the issuance of 8.85 billion UNCN tokens (capped at 20% at launch, 5% monthly thereafter) in exchange for Philippine and Papua New Guinea real estate valued at $1.58 billion. The filing describes a non-cash, token-for-property exchange with a 60% Philippine-ownership legal structure, no board recommendation or advisor mentioned. This is not a standard special-situation M&A or capital-return event but a cryptocurrency-based asset acquisition. Watch for regulatory and token-liquidity risks.
